environment.description: Same Kubernetes pod but with a custom OCI runtime seccomp profile applied via annotation 'seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod' referencing a localhost profile at /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/stream-processor-hardened.json. The profile uses a whitelist (defaultAction: SCMP_ACT_ERRNO) permitting only: read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, rt_sigreturn, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, madvise, nanosleep, getpid, clone, uname, fcntl, flock, fsync, fdatasync, ftruncate, getdents64, getcwd, chdir, openat, newfstatat, lseek, getrandom, futex, epoll_create1, epoll_ctl, epoll_pwait, eventfd2, tgkill, exit_group, arch_prctl, set_tid_address, set_robust_list, prlimit64, clock_gettime, gettid, sigaltstack. Notably absent: execve, execveat, fork, vfork, clone3 (with CLONE_THREAD only permitted via clone), connect, socket, bind, listen, accept, sendto, recvfrom, sendmsg, recvmsg, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, personality, pivot_root, mount, umount2.
